messages:
Sam (SE): Hey team, Taylor requested SIEM ingest samples, retention commitments, and a deletion proof for the POC.

Jordan (AE): Taylor, you mentioned Splunk over TLS. Confirm we should target tcp/6514 syslog?

Taylor (Customer): Yes tcp/6514 TLS to our ingest node. Need admin audit retained >= 12 months and proof of deletion.

Sam (SE): For the POC we can stream syslog (tcp/6514 TLS) or drop gzipped JSON to S3 every 5 minutes.

Sam (SE): Minimal syslog sample we will send: {"event_type":"admin_change","actor":"alice@acme","action":"role_grant","timestamp":"2026-02-15T18:20:00Z","request_id":"req-123"} (PII redacted).

Eve (CISO): Retention defaults: admin audit 24 months, request traces 90 days. We can lower admin to 12 months for contracted enterprise. All exports encrypted SSE-KMS; we support CMKs.

Jordan (AE): Action: we'll produce an attestation PDF and a 10-event JSONL sample (includes admin change, service restart, masked request trace). ETA: tomorrow EOD.

doc-bot: Reference doc: https://redwood.internal/security/logging (internal access).

Taylor (Customer): Also need JSON schema for fields so Splunk extraction is straightforward.

Sam (SE): Will attach schema.json: fields event_type, actor, actor_role, timestamp, resource, action, request_id, client_ip, raw_payload_redacted.

Taylor (Customer): For deletion, show CLI and audit evidence of purge and job completion.

Eve (CISO): We'll provide a deletion audit sample showing command, actor, job_id, start and completion timestamps, and confirmation. Example command: redwood-admin delete-customer-data --customer-id=acme-987 --confirm.

Jordan (AE): I'll bundle: attestation.pdf, sample_events.jsonl, schema.json, syslog_config.txt, deletion_audit.json and share a signed link.

Taylor (Customer): Great. Can we have a 20-min demo after you drop the ZIP?

Sam (SE): Scheduling a 20-min walkthrough tomorrow. Invite sent. Thanks all :thumbsup:
